It's light, easy to use, and deals a decent amount of damage.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 6 |durability = 15 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Spiked Boko Spear}} Spiked Boko Spears are upgraded [[Boko Spear]]s that have been enhanced using [[Animal]] bones. They are used most often by [[Blue Bokoblin]]s and [[Blue Moblin]]s in the [[Faron Grasslands]] and [[East Necluda]]. They belong to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipent, which includes all [[Weapon]]s made by Bokoblins.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Known to be light and easy to use, they deal a decent amount of damage. When scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] Rune, the {{BotW}} Series [[Bokoblin]] [[amiibo]] has a chance of spawning a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Spiked Boko Spear. Being made of wood, Spiked Boko Spears will float in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] if they are dropped. They will also burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], and they do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]] or conduct [[Electricity]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_005" |Life = 15 |Power = 6 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 10 |BuyingPrice = 15 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Spear }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:AoC Spiked Boko Spear Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Spiked Boko Spear ==See Also== {{See Also| * Boko Spear * Bokoblin Gear * Dragonbone Boko Spear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bokoblin Gear, Spears, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
